annotation.title_clean: Interim Report: Toward Harmonized AI Policies and Recommendations for the Caribbean
annotation.title_en: Interim Report: Toward Harmonized AI Policies and Recommendations for the Caribbean
annotation.authors_or_issuer: CARICOM Caribbean Telecommunications Union (CTU) Caribbean AI Task Force (CAITF)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Interim report of the CARICOM CTU Caribbean AI Task Force recommending a harmonised regional AI governance framework grounded in human-centric, rights-based, inclusive principles with emphasis on data sovereignty. Proposes five action areas: policy architecture, data governance and infrastructure, sectoral innovation, capacity building, and multi-stakeholder engagement. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for a harmonised CARICOM-wide AI policy framework with model laws, shared oversight, procurement and audit standards
Proposes modernised data protection, a Caribbean Data Commons, regional data centres and HPC
Recommends innovation funds, sandboxes and Caribbean-trained language models for priority sectors
Urges AI literacy, curriculum reform and a regional research hub
Proposes a Caribbean AI Forum and national advisory mechanisms; final report due 2026
